execution_limitations: First scopes ran in workspace, resumed scopes in /tmp after verified archive recovery; shared CPU and mixed storage make timing descriptive.
Recorded delivery-before-score chronology and frozen code are not operating-system process-memory isolation proof.
Continuous gains validate an appropriate Gaussian inductive bias, not a distinct new activation function class.

final_go_no_go.basis: Two positive continuous-model primary gates coexist with a strongly negative pulse primary gate, equivalent classical model behavior, inconclusive encoding benefit, and failed bounded retention. All effects and failures remain in the evidence.
final_go_no_go.go: Retain the verified analytic kernel, prediction head and evidence infrastructure as research assets; expand explicitly registered tasks if desired.
no_go: Do not promote this stochastic pulse architecture over the continuous candidate.
Do not claim a distinct activation/function-class discovery over Gaussian/probit filtering.
Do not claim analytic feedback encoding improves net utility over the numeric or same-information history references.
Do not claim the registered bounded retention target passed or that lifelong memory was demonstrated.
Do not replace the production Hepta neuron or close its original blockers using these synthetic research results.

independent_review_scope: Raw utility means, pairing, counts, exact gates and alpha independently verified; frozen bootstrap implementation reviewed, bootstrap not rerun; scope artifact audits already passed.

main_research_judgement.continuous_probability_head: Advance as a Gaussian/probit predictive-head research candidate on explicitly declared domains. Two registered synthetic-task superiority gates passed.
main_research_judgement.function_class_novelty: Not established. Independently implemented equivalent Gaussian model has utility difference -4.7704895589362195e-18.
main_research_judgement.mechanism: Sampled pulse underperforms matched mean-drive recurrence by 0.09459110882734911 in descriptive comparison; reset effect interval crosses zero. Do not infer universal SNN limits.
main_research_judgement.policy_value: Analytic policy beats all four forced analytic policies in descriptive comparisons, including always-wait-repair by 0.09124331386009914. This supports actual action selection value under public tariffs.
main_research_judgement.pulse_architecture: Do not promote current pulse architecture: registered comparison failed with all five seed differences negative and entire adjusted interval below zero.

ood_interpretation.cross_law: Event frequencies and task difficulty differ across laws; compare paired arms within a law, not raw NLL values across laws as calibration evidence.
ood_interpretation.drift_shift: Analytic remains better than tested history/native baselines, but own utility drops to 0.31059895803093934, event ECE rises to 0.05803306433519301 and privileged known-law oracle utility is 0.5088118775930056. Relative baseline gains do not establish immunity to misspecification.
ood_interpretation.student_t: All intervals remain descriptive. Student-t(4) lacks a fourth moment, so squared-loss variance and ordinary bootstrap coverage need not be finite/valid; no population noninferiority conclusion.

primary_gate_interpretation.additional_requirement: All five seed mean differences strictly positive
primary_gate_interpretation.sampling_limit: Five training seeds; empirical percentile intervals are not finite-sample coverage guarantees.

reporting_compatibility_assessment.reason: Only Boolean severe-loss indicators were exactly recoded as float64 0/1 in temporary analysis copies. Original files, original statistical source, utility arrays, bootstrap and acceptance rules unchanged. The adapter and decision were recorded before the first primary bootstrap.

feedback.judgement: Actual delivered feedback changes original two-tick state and behavior. No demonstrated extra utility over numeric encoding or matched-history: both empirical 95% intervals cross zero. Positive zero/reset comparisons support feedback-dependent selection over uninformative constant policies in this secondary task, not production superiority or long-term memory.

retention.judgement: Replay reduces forgetting relative to pure online adaptation, but exceeds the declared old-task degradation margin by more than fourfold. New-task improvement does not rescue the failed joint retention gate. Three supervised windows do not establish indefinite memory.
retention.record_aliasing: Each recorded final model matches its fit; next window starts from prior final model; frozen model remains unchanged.
retention.training_data_provenance: Every fit digest independently matches only registered new-training and/or original-training rows; no old/new holdout enters fitting. Source order generates new holdout after adaptation.
